Commentary.Commentary: Bangladesh were lackluster in the field and conceded some easy runs. Mehedi Hasan was the pick of the bowlers, picking up two wickets. Saifuddin bowled a brilliant final over but the partnership of 61 from 31 between Miller and Behardien, where the latter dominated, allowed the Proteas to finish on a high. It is a steep task for the visitors but stranger things have happened in cricket. Join us for the chase shortly.

South Africa will be really happy with the score after electing to bat first. They didn't have the best of starts as Amla departed cheaply trying to force the issue. But then, in came AB de Villiers and stamped his authority from the word go. De Kock played a free-flowing knock from the other end as well to maintain a healthy run rate.
Brilliant yorker on middle, jammed out to mid-wicket for a run. Good final over from Saifuddin. SOUTH AFRICA FINISH ON 195/4.
Another one in the blockhole on off, Farhaan digs it out to extra cover for a single.
Tailing in on a fullish length on middle, David makes room and only manages to ply it to mid off for a single.
Very full outside off, Behardien whacks it to deep cover for a single.
FOUR! Behardien is playing a gem of a knock! Saifuddin rolls his fingers on this one and bowls a short delivery. Behardien spots it and swats it over mid-wicket for a boundary.

Excellent bowling! Pinpoint yorker on the boots, Miller clears his front leg and looks to whip it across but is hit on the back leg. The ball rolls to the leg side and the batsmen take a leg bye. That hit him on the heel of the leg, that must hurt.
SIX! Brilliant! Just used the pace of the delivery there. Fullish delivery slanting down the leg side, Behardien kneels and sweeps it over deep square leg for a maximum.
Fullish delivery on middle and leg, Farhaan hits it straight back to Islam who mimes a throw back to the keeper's end.
Full length delivery in line of the stumps, Behardien backs away and knocks it to long on. A couple taken.
Bouncer in line of the stumps, Miller mistimes his pull to mid-wicket to rotate strike.
FOUR! Nicely placed! Islam bowls the slower one on a shorter length outside off. Miller reads it well and guides it past the point fielder to pick up another boundary.
Back of a length delivery, Miller flat-bats it to wide long on for a couple.
SIX! What a shot! Fuller length ball around off, Behardien carves it over extra over for half a dozen. That was all about timing and grace.
Angling into Farhaan who goes for a hoick across the line but drags it to deep mid-wicket for a couple.
Poor fielding! Behardien crunches this one to Mehedi at sweeper cover. He attacks the ball but fumbles to concede a couple.
Full length ball outside off, carved away to sweeper cover for a run.
Another low full toss, Miller backs away and hits it hard to wide long on. Rahman runs across to his left and stops it. A couple taken.
Low full toss, drilled through mid on for a run.
Taskin Ahmed is back on.
Low full toss on the pads, Miller helps it past the short fine leg fielder. The fielder from deep square leg covers a lot of ground and saves a couple for his side.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Attacking the stumps with a curling full delivery, Miller eases it to wide mid on for a run.
Full length delivery in line of the stumps, clipped through mid-wicket for a another couple.
Fullish delivery, Behardien goes for the heave but drags it to deep square leg for a brace.
Beamer! No ball and Four Byes! High full toss down the leg side, Behardien ducks under it. Rahim dives to his left but fails to stop it and the ball rolls to the fine leg fence.
Yorker on off, Miller jams it out to mid off for a brisk single.
Tossed up outside off, Behardien slaps it through wide mid off. Rahman in the deep races to his right and slides to keep it down to a couple.
Goes deep in the crease and punches it to sweeper cover for a run.
Eases this one past the bowler to long off to rotate strike.
FOUR! Well played! Seam up delivery on a short length on middle and leg, Behardien pulls it with aplomb over mid-wicket to pick up a boundary.
Fullish delivery, Behardien works it through wide mid on for a couple. Gets off the mark as well.
The batsman plays a sweep shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Farhaan Behardien strides out to bat.

OUT! De Kock departs against the run of play! He shuffles across and Hossain attacks the stumps with a full length delivery. He looks to paddle it away but is struck on the boots. Bangladesh roar in appeal and up goes the umpire's finger. Quinton is not happy and walks back dejected. The review was there to be used but he doesn't. Is he aware? Good call in the end as the Hawk Eye shows the pitching was umpire's call and the rest were two reds. Outstanding over by Rubel, just 3 runs and a big wicket from it!
Wide! Full length delivery in the same channel, de Kock looks to sweep it but misses and the ball just goes past the leg stump. A wide is signaled but Rahim is not pleased.
Angles this one in again from around leg stump, Miller looks to clip it across but gets an inside edge onto his pads. The batsmen sneak in a run.

An appeal for an LBW is denied! Full length delivery around leg stump, Miller tries to play it across but is hit on the pads. Hossain is interested but the umpire shakes his head. That pitched outside leg, showed the replays.
Third man in place now.
Another full toss, de Kock mistimes it to long off for a single.
Close shave! Full toss on middle, de Kock makes room and looks to go over covers but is not in a good position. Ends up getting an outside edge past the off stump and towards the keeper.
A play and a miss! Length delivery slanting across de Kock. He goes for an agricultural slog across the line but gets beaten. He gave this one his all but missed out.
Rubel Hossain returns for a bowl.
De Kock works this one through mid on for a single.
Miller hangs back and punches it through covers for a run.
Short ball outside off, cut to backward point.
Shuffles across to this one and clips it to mid-wicket for a single.
Fullish delivery, clipped with the angle through mid-wicket for a brace.
Shortish outside off, cut past point for a run.
Works this one to the leg side for a run. End of an eventful over.
David Miller is the next man in!

OUT! Good awareness from Kayes! Tossed up around off, Duminy uses his feet and muscles it over mid off. Kayes in the deep runs across to his left, gets his hands to it but it's hit so ferociously that the ball pops out from his hands. He, although, recovers well and takes it in the second attempt with a dive. Bangladesh need to keep chipping away at the wickets.
Fullish delivery, driven through mid on for a run.

SIX! Brings up his 2nd T20I fifty in style! Slow through the air and full outside off, de Kock kneels and slog sweeps it over deep mid-wicket for a huge biggie. That came right off the screws. This is also his highest T20I score.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. One run added to the total.

Not Out! That was touch and go. Duminy plays this one with the spin through wide mid on for a run and calls his partner through for the second. The fielder returns an accurate throw and seems to have hit the bull's eye at the bowler's end as de Kock dives in to make his ground. It is referred upstairs. The replays roll in. It seems as Shakib has touched the bails with his hand before the ball hit the stumps. The third umpire looks at it from a different angle. It is not clear whether the bail got dislodge from the hand or not. Also the bails are not entirely off and de Kock seems to have just made the crease. After a lot of deliberation, the benefit of the doubt goes to the batsman. Fair enough.
There is a run out appeal which is taken upstairs against de Kock. Shakib seems to have disturbed one of the bails before the ball hit the stumps. A tough call for the TV umpire this...
Shakib is back on!
Tossed up delivery, eased to long off for a run.
Sliding in with the angle, Duminy looks to clip it away but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They manage to come back for the second.
SIX! That's a gift and it is duly accepted! Juicy full toss on off, Duminy smokes it over mid-wicket for a maximum.

Coming in with the arm, Duminy comes down the track and looks to clip it through mid-wicket but misses to get struck on the pads. Hasan appeals confidently but the umpire stays put. That was clearly going down the leg side.
Floated delivery, knocked down to long off for a run.
Duminy rocks back and cuts it with the spin to point.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. They pick up a single.
De Kock uses his feet and chips it over the bowler's head for a couple.
Shortish in length, cut to the man at backward point.
Full delivery, whipped to wide long on for a run.
Tossed up delivery, played with soft hands to mid-wicket for a run.
The skipper, JP Duminy walks out to bat next. Also, there is a bowling change as Mahmudullah comes on to bowl.

OUT! AB de Villiers departs after a brilliant knock! However, he will be disappointed to miss out on a fifty by a mere run. Full delivery on off, de Villiers swings across the line but skews it off the outer half towards long off. Mahmudullah lines it up, takes it reverse cup and after that, tumbles down. The 79-run stand from 48 balls comes to an end. Boundaries dried up and AB tried to break the shackles but miscued his shot. Good pressure bowling by Bangladesh, a bit of a comeback for them.
Makes room and drills it against the spin to sweeper cover for a couple.
Fullish delivery in line of the stumps, de Kock goes for the fancy reverse sweep and connects well but finds Taskin at short third man.
Spinning into AB de Villiers who turns it to mid-wicket for a run.
On leg stump, AB chips it over wide mid on to collect a brace.
De Kock mistimes this one besides the pitch on the off side but still calls his partner through for a swift single.
Short delivery, cut away against the spin past point for a run. Back-to-back good overs for the visiting team, 7 from it, 13 in the last two.
Driven through the covers by the batsman. They pick up a single.

Poor fielding again! Short and room on offer, de Villiers cuts it towards sweeper cover and takes a run. Soumya Sarkar fumbles and seeing that, de Kock sets off. Shakib fails to collect it as well. An extra run taken.
Tossed up delivery, Quinton creams it to long off to get off strike.
Arm delivery, punched to long off for a single.
Fraction short, de Kock pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Shakib Al Hasan to roll his arm over again.
Chips down the track and works it against the spin to long on for a single. Finally some sanity prevails for Bangladesh, only 6 runs from the over.
De Villiers is once again nimble on his feet and clips it all along the ground to deep mid-wicket. A single taken.
Floated outside off, driven with the spin to sweeper cover for a single.
Uses his feet to this one and strokes it to mid on for a run.
Brilliant effort, Saifuddin! Short delivery, de Kock rocks back and cuts it with the spin towards backward point. Saifuddin dives full length to his right and saves a certain boundary.
Full on leg stump, clipped to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Mehedi Hasan returns for a bowl.
Eases this one through mid on for a run and will retain strike. Another good over for Proteas, 12 from it!
FOUR! De Villiers is toying with the youngster. Full delivery well outside off, AB bends and carves it past the point region to find the fence.
FOUR! Brute power! Half-volley around off, de Villiers powers it past the right side of Soumya Sarkar at sweeper cover for a boundary.

Bangladesh are not looking good in the field. Fullish delivery outside off, de Villiers hammers it towards Sarkar at sweeper cover who makes a half-stop but is not sure where the ball is. Suddenly realizes that it has rolled behind but has not crossed the fence. He goes back and by that time, two runs are taken. That brings up the 50-run stand between the duo as well.
Fractionally overpitched around off, de Villiers strokes it towards Shakib at extra cover who dives to his right and stops it. He is ringing his hand, looks to be in pain.
Bouncer in line of the stumps, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Mohammad Saifuddin to have a burst now. The youngster will be eager to impress.

FOUR! Three in a row! On a length around off, de Villiers makes room and lifts it over the extra cover region. The timing is spot on and the ball whistles away to the fence. Breezy start for South Africa, 65 runs in the Powerplay. 18 from this one.

FOUR! The dynamic Protea batsman is in the zone. Ominous signs for opposition. De Villiers shuffles across and Islam attacks the stumps with a low full toss. AB kneels and sweeps it through backward square leg for a boundary.
FOUR! Sloppy work! Short delivery, de Villiers goes for the pull but gets it off the inner half towards the fielder at short fine leg. He makes a mess of it, allowing it to go through to the fence.
On a length around off, de Villiers drives it hard to mid off.
Wide! Again a poor delivery, slanting down the leg side. AB tries to put bat on ball but misses.
FOUR! Easy pickings! On a length down the leg side, de Villiers picks it up past the left side of short fine leg and the ball races to the fence.

A tight run! Length delivery around off, de Kock drops it on the pitch and calls his partner through for a run. Islam runs towards the ball but fails to collect it. Had he collected, a run out was on at the bowler's end.
Shafiul Islam to have a bowl now.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Full length ball on off, de Villiers makes room and hammers it through extra cover to find the fence. 14 from the over.

FOUR! That has been struck with authority! Short delivery on off, sits up nicely for de Villiers. He stands tall and pulls it hard over mid-wicket for a boundary. That almost carried the whole distance.
Wide! Low full toss well outside off, AB aims to carve it away but misses. Wide called by the umpire.
De Villiers makes room to the full length delivery and drills it to extra cover. He looks for a run but it is not on. Moves back to the crease as the fielder misses his shy at the striker's end.
Fuller in length around off, de Villiers goes at it with hard hands and mistimes it to mid off.
Full delivery on the boots, Quinton flicks it to deep mid-wicket to rotate strike.
FOUR! De Kock is oozing confidence! Fullish delivery outside off, Quinton walks a couple of steps down the track and drives it elegantly through extra cover to find the fence.
Ahmed runs in from around the wicket and bangs the deck hard. De Kock looks to work it across but the ball hits the high part of his willow and rolls near the pitch. The batsmen sneak in a run.
Angling into de Villiers who tucks it around the corner for an easy run.
Good length ball on middle and leg, turned to the leg side for a brisk run.
Back of a length well outside off, de Kock cracks it but straight to Rahman at backward point.

A loud appeal for an LBW, turned down! Length delivery on off, de Kock shuffles across and looks to play it across but is struck on the pads. Ahmed is very confident but the umpire stays put. The replays show that it was clearly missing the off stump.
FOUR! Hammered! Fuller length ball outside off, de Kock bludgeons it down the ground past mid off for a rocketing boundary.
Taskin Ahmed comes into the attack.
Good length delivery in the zone of apprehension, de Kock flat-bats it to mid off for a run.
Wide! Hossain loses his radar and slips it down the leg side. Quinton leaves it alone.
FOUR! Not off the meat of the bat but gets the desired result! Slower short delivery, de Kock shuffles across and goes for the pull but gloves it past the keeper and through to the fine leg fence.
Short and room on offer, de Villiers slaps it to deep point for a run.
Rubel Hossain in some pain. The physio is attending to him and out comes the magic spray. He seems to be alright now and is raring to go again.

Ooh.. that's nasty! Length ball on off, de Villiers hammers it straight to Hossain who bends in his followthrough and looks to stop it with his right hand but is struck right on the thumb. He is down on the ground and his teammates encircle him.
Back of a length outside off, de Kock drops it besides the pitch on the off side for a brisk single.
Full length delivery on off, de Kock drills it to mid off.
AB de Villiers comes out to bat. Meanwhile, Rubel Hossain comes for a bowl now.

OUT! Bowled 'em! Good bowling from Mehedi brings the reward. Flatter delivery on off, skids through the surface. Amla looks to open up the off side, plays for the spin and gets beaten to find his off stump rattled. Ideal start for Bangladesh!
Quinton strokes this one to wide mid off to rotate strike.
FOUR! Well executed! De Kock makes room to the flighted ball and goes inside out over extra cover for a boundary. He is looking in good touch.
Floated outside off, Quinton eases it with the spin through extra cover. Proactive running between the duo allows them to come back for the second.
Quinton missed out there! Short and spinning away, de Kock cuts it straight to Islam at backward point.
On the pads, tucked to mid-wicket for a run.
Spin from both ends. Mehedi Hasan to share the new ball.

Interestingly, the jersey Quinton de Kock is wearing also has Amla written behind it. Hmm...new kind of superstition? Or maybe he didn't get his jersey on time. Anyway, doesn't matter, he is off and running quite well.
Too short, de Kock stands tall and pulls it hard through wide mid on. Sabbir Rahman runs to his left and keeps it down to a couple. 10 from the first over.
Fraction short again, punched to mid on for an easy run.
Floated delivery, Quinton uses his feet and milks it down to long on for a run.
FOUR! Shot! Tossed up around off, de Kock lines it up, kneels and slog sweeps it over mid-wicket. Beats the man in the deep to earn himself a boundary.
Fullish delivery on off, Amla strokes it to long off for an easy run and gets off the mark as well.
South Africa are away! Shakib starts off with a short ball on off, de Kock drags it to long on for a run.

The players are out in the middle for their respective national anthems. After the completion, we are all set to get underway. The weather is bright and sunny, excellent conditions to play cricket. Quinton de Kock and Hashim Amla will open the batting for the Proteas. Bangladesh begin with spin. Shakib Al Hasan to roll his arm over with the new ball. Here we go...
TOSS - South Africa win the toss and opt to bat. Robbie Frylinck makes his international debut for the hosts, a big moment for him.

On the other hand, the Bangla Tigers have been all at sea so far. Shakib Al Hasan will captain his country and needs to inspire his boys to change their fortunes. The fast-paced nature of the game might give them the best opportunity to showcase their potential. Expect a thrilling encounter!

Hello and a warm welcome to the coverage of the 1st T20I between South Africa and Bangladesh in Bloemfontein. The Proteas have ruled the roost in their home conditions so far and will be aiming to dominate the proceedings in the shortest format as well. The hosts will be testing their bench strength, more so in the bowling department and Robbie Frylinck might make his international debut.
